runtime: Offline Manila building shards merge data/facades/cities/manila/buildings.geojson, building-footprints.geojson and building-details.geojson by normalized OSM feature ID. Primary consolidated geometry and populated primary tags take precedence; supplemental footprint/detail properties fill missing attributes and unmatched building polygons are added once. Generated facade-window GeoJSON remains disabled in the Android runtime.

photo_facade_textures.status: No human-verified building/photo matches are currently available; no candidate photo may be assigned automatically.

building_source.runtime_role: sole source of building polygons and properties; no footprint/detail supplementation

street_source.runtime_role: always imported for named street-label geometry; labels overlay PBF road surfaces without replacing them

windows.note: Archived generated GeoJSON; not loaded, rendered, or required for APK builds
